system.description:
You outstretch a free hand and fire off the bones in your fingers like bullets with enough force to tear through armor and flesh like paper. You can select up to three creatures within range that you can see.

Make a single ranged taijutsu attack, comparing the result against the selected creatures AC. On a hit, a target takes 4d6 Piercing damage.

Battle Lust: By spending 1 Battle Lust when this jutsu is cast, you can choose to instead target a single creature, and make a number of Taijutsu attacks against the same creature equal to the number of creatures you can target minus 1, dealing 2d6 piercing damage on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
